name: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung
short_description: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung was a half marathon and 10 km held over two days, 19 and 20 September 2026, from Balai Kota Bandung, Indonesia.
ai_summary: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung was held over two days in Bandung, Indonesia: the 10 km on Saturday 19 September 2026 and the half marathon, the main race, on Sunday 20 September 2026. Both started and finished at Balai Kota Bandung, by Taman Vanda on Jalan Merdeka. The organiser reported 16,000 runners: 7,600 in the 10 km and 8,400 in the half.

core_facts.venue: Balai Kota Bandung (Taman Vanda, Jl. Merdeka)

pros: Half marathon and 10 km on separate days, so the fields do not share the road
Pre-dawn half-marathon start that runners describe as cool
Route tours central Bandung, from Dago to Asia Afrika
Runners and the city reported far less conflict with traffic in 2026 than in 2024
cons: Roads are shared with traffic, not closed
Strict half-marathon cut-off: 13.8 km within 2 hours 30 for the last wave
Tickets sold only through Blibli, one per account
No full marathon, and no winning times published for 2026

research_highlights: The 2026 edition was held on 19-20 September 2026, with the 10K on Saturday and the half marathon on Sunday; the 2024 and 2025 Bandung editions were held in July.
In the 2025 edition, start/finish moved from Gedung Sate to Balai Kota Bandung, and half marathon start time was pushed earlier (4:00 AM) specifically to reduce traffic disruption and finish sooner.
Bandung's cool morning climate is repeatedly cited by organizers and past participants as a favorable running condition compared to other Indonesian cities.
Course has historically run past Bandung landmarks such as Jalan Asia Afrika, Dago, Diponegoro, and Ir. H. Juanda, giving a scenic city-tour feel.
The event is hybrid: a large offline race in Bandung plus a much larger virtual race component (in 2025, roughly 16,000 ran offline versus over 30,000 virtual participants nationwide).
research_watchouts: The 2024 edition drew significant criticism after half-marathon and marathon runners had to share roads with motorbikes and cars, with some runners reporting horn-honking and even verbal abuse from drivers.

The 2025 edition caused notable traffic congestion in central Bandung (e.g. Cicadas, Kiaracondong, Viaduct areas), prompting complaints from residents and criticism from a Bandung city council member.

Local officials and city planners have publicly acknowledged recurring problems with road closures/route planning and pledged evaluation and improvements for future editions, suggesting logistics around road use remain a live issue.

Some residents on social media expressed skepticism that lessons from the prior year's complaints were being applied, indicating community friction around the race is a recurring theme rather than a one-off.

faqs.question: When was the Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung?
faqs.answer: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung was held over two days. The 10 km was run on Saturday 19 September 2026 and the half marathon on Sunday 20 September 2026, with separate tickets for each day. The 2024 and 2025 Bandung editions were held in July.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The Bandung event offered two races: a half marathon, the main race, and a 10 km. Local reports gave the course lengths as about 21.3 km and 10.2 km. There was no full marathon; the organiser said a 42 km route would have to loop much more of Bandung.

faqs.question: Where does the race start and finish?
faqs.answer: Both races started and finished at Balai Kota Bandung, the city hall, around Taman Vanda on Jalan Merdeka. The routes ran through central Bandung, including Jalan Ir. H. Juanda (Dago) and Diponegoro, with the half marathon going on to Kiaracondong and Asia Afrika. Roads were shared with traffic rather than closed.
